name: case11-grounded-rules-v1
scope: case_11 digital author-layout paper, six letter-size pages

rules.title: 任务参数约束
rules.summary: 计算需求、截止期与周期的关系来自原文的参数不等式。

sources.pattern: C i (?P<execution_bound>≤|<|>=|<=|>|≥) D i (?P<deadline_bound>≤|<|>=|<=|>|≥) T i

rules.title: DM 优先级
rules.summary: 相对截止期越短，优先级越高。

sources.pattern: Thus, the process with the shortest deadline is assigned the highest priority and the longest deadline process is assigned the lowest priority\.

rules.title: 零星任务最小释放间隔
rules.summary: 相邻释放至少相隔 m；实际释放无需保持周期性。

sources.pattern: However, we note that since the process is sporadic, the actual release times of the process will not be periodic, but successive releases will be separated by no less than m time units\.

rules.title: 零星任务截止期约束
rules.summary: 原文给出零星任务截止期与最小释放间隔的关系，见抽取表达式。

rules.title: 周期与零星任务混合
rules.summary: 论文声明允许周期和零星任务混合使用。

sources.pattern: No limitations on the combination of periodic and sporadic processes are imposed by this scheme\.

rules.title: 抢占调度的背景说明
rules.summary: 引言在介绍 RM 时描述了抢占机制和最高优先级就绪任务运行。

sources.pattern: At runtime a preemptive scheduling mechanism is used: the highest priority runnable process is executed\.

review_issues: 该段属于 RM 背景，是否作为 DM 模型条件需另行确认。

rules.title: 独立任务的背景说明
rules.summary: 引言列举了 RM 背景下的周期、独立和截止期等于周期约束。

sources.pattern: processes must be periodic, independent and have deadline equal to period\.

review_issues: 不能将 RM 背景中的全部限制直接并入 DM 模型。

rules.title: 同步扩展的范围
rules.summary: 作者将任务同步和变化的时序特征留作进一步研究。

sources.pattern: These include the effect of allowing processes to synchronise and vary their timing characteristics\.

review_issues: 该句不直接规定自挂起、调度开销或初始状态。

rules.title: 测试 (1)
rules.summary: 第一个测试使用截止期内高优先级释放次数的保守干扰估计。

sources.pattern: Note: R x H evaluates to the smallest integer ≥ x ; Q x P evaluates to the largest integer ≤ x
The schedulability constraints given by equations \(1\) and \(2\) are sufficient but not necessary in the general case\.

review_issues: 公式字符存在错位。规范式来自 case_11 核对模板，需要逐项对照原页确认。

rules.title: 测试 (2)
rules.summary: 第二个测试对截止期之后的执行部分进行截断。

sources.pattern: The schedulability constraints given by equations \(1\) and \(2\) are sufficient but not necessary in the general case\.

review_issues: 取整、求和上下标和截断项需按公式图核对。

rules.title: Fig.3 迭代测试
rules.summary: 逐任务迭代干扰与执行需求，检查时间界限。

normalized.accept: I_i(t) + C_i <= t AND t <= D_i

review_issues: 原伪代码在每轮末尾检查 t>D_i。规范化接受条件保留截止期检查。
初值包含自身及全部高优先级任务，公式和求和上下标需要页图确认。

rules.title: 迭代测试的接受充分性
rules.summary: 在论文模型及优先级约束下，所有任务通过最终迭代测试即可保证可调度。

sources.pattern: This problem was resolved with the development of a sufficient and necessary schedulability test\.
This test is able to determine the schedulability of any fixed priority process set where deadlines are no greater than periods, whatever the priority assignment criteria used\.

review_issues: 这是从原文充分且必要声明中取出的充分性方向。整数时间和合法轨迹的精确量化由项目合同另行规定。

rules.title: 迭代测试的精确性
rules.summary: 最终测试被声明为充分且必要。

sources.pattern: This problem was resolved with the development of a sufficient and necessary schedulability test\.
This test is able to determine the schedulability of any fixed priority process set where deadlines are no greater than periods, whatever the priority assignment criteria used\.

review_issues: 必要性方向及到达相位量化需单独确认。

rules.title: DM 优先级分配最优性
rules.summary: 在相应任务模型下，若存在可行静态优先级分配，DM 也可行。

sources.pattern: Deadline-monotonic priority assignment is an optimal static priority scheme \(see theorem 2\.4 in \(Leung, 1982\) \)\.

review_issues: 原文引用 Leung 1982 的定理；原定理来源与前提需要核对。

rules.title: 任意固定优先级的测试充分性
rules.summary: 最终测试也适用于截止期不超过周期的任意给定固定优先级顺序。

sources.pattern: This test is able to determine the schedulability of any fixed priority process set where deadlines are no greater than periods, whatever the priority assignment criteria used\.
This problem was resolved with the development of a sufficient and necessary schedulability test\.
